claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mocetinostat kills cells at 2.5 uM predominantly through HDAC inhibition, a cytotoxic class effect shared with other hydroxamic acid HDAC inhibitors, with possible contribution from cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress at this concentration.
